_note: SPAMML league scoring layer (DECISIONS #27). Scoring is ACTUAL NFL points only: every player on a scoring play is credited its full value (a passing TD pays the QB 6 and the receiver 6). No yards, receptions, turnovers or sacks. No bench: every rostered player starts. A bye week scores 0.

kicker_env.evidence: 2023-25 weeks 4-12, kicker-games with >=3 prior games, outcome = 3*FG + XP. Only the team's market implied points predict next-game kicker points (in-sample r=0.135, 5-fold CV r=0.09). Trailing kicker points (r=0.01), kicker FG accuracy, kicker FG attempts per game and team FG attempts per game (red-zone stall) add nothing out of sample. 5-fold CV MAE 2.922 vs 3.102 for the trailing-8-game average. Reproduce: engine/weekly/kicker_bt.py

rule._note: Dropping a player who projects above 0 this week is irreversible (another team claims him), so it needs a gain of min_gain_irreversible AND a candidate whose ytd TD rate is not above hot_streak_ratio times his projection. Dropping a player who scores 0 this week (bye, out) needs any gain. Kickers within k_tie_band points are tied and ordered by team implied points.
